```{r}
root <- "/home/jan/Documents/diplomska_naloga"
files <- list.files(file.path(root, "atlas_db/COM"), full.names = TRUE)
```
```{r}
d <- read.csv(files[1])
head(d)

```
Imam time series razdalj med masnima centroma. Naredi parne razlike, meaning za koliko se spremeni (poveča, pomanjša) razdalja med i-tim in i+1-im korakom.
```{r}
d2 <- 0
for (i in 2:nrow(d)) {
    d2 <- c(d2, d$R1[i + 1] - d$R1[i])
}
d2[length(d2)] <- 0

```
```{r}
plot(d2, type = "l")
lines(1:length(d2), rep(0, length(d2)), col = "red")

```
```{r}
library(astsa)
par(
  bg = "black", # Barva ozadja
  fg = "#606060", # Osnovna barva (okvirji in črte)
  col.axis = "#606060", # Oznake na oseh (številke)
  col.lab = "#606060", # Imeta osi
  col.main = "#606060" # Glavni naslov
)

k <- kernel("daniell", 2)
mvspec(d2, kernel = k, col = "cyan")

```
```{r}
mvspec(d$R1, kernel = k)

```
